description_text: Condensed from the public post. Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, custom values, snapshots, and landing pages for new clients as directed by Account Managers. Build multi-step Zaps with paths, filters, formatters, and webhooks. Run a daily system health check of GHL and Zapier error logs and resolve breaks. Triage Slack messages and support tickets, resolving 95% within 24 hours. Root-cause broken automations and add safeguards. Maintain client automation playbooks; log build and support hours in ClickUp; QA-test every workflow before handoff. Must know: complex GHL workflows, pipelines, custom values, snapshots, landing pages, sub-account configuration, and debugging without help; Zapier multi-step Zaps with paths, filters, formatters, and webhooks and when to use Zapier versus GHL-native automation; integrations with field-service tools such as Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, or Jobber; webhooks, basic API concepts, and JSON; documentation and clear English on video calls. Requires 4+ years of hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and Zapier.
